title: Toward Quantum-Optimized Flow Scheduling in Multi-Beam Digital Satellites
summary: Data flow scheduling for high-throughput multibeam satellites is a challenging NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem. As the problem scales, traditional methods, such as Mixed-Integer Linear Programming and heuristic schedulers, often face a trade-off between solution quality and real-time feasibility. In this paper, we present a hybrid quantum-classical framework that improves scheduling efficiency by casting Multi-Beam Time-Frequency Slot Assignment (MB-TFSA) as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem.
